label: Estimated dealer gamma: short (convention-based, SPY)
detail: When dealers are short gamma, intraday moves have tended to extend into the close, and that extension has reverted over the following days (Baltussen, Da, Lammers & Martens 2021). A volatility read, not a direction call. Caveat: the public-data sign rule (dealers long calls, short puts) overstates 'short gamma' — signed S&P option data show dealers net long gamma most of the time — so treat the sign as uncertain; gamma walls and the flip level have no peer-reviewed support as price targets.

evidence.note: Volatility only; sign uncertain. Baltussen et al. 2021 (JFE); Amaya et al. 2025; Adams et al. (draft).
